description: IRA owner born in 1936, age 90 in 2026.
worked:
IRA owner born 1936-10-31; age attained on the 2026 birthday = 2026 - 1936 = 90. Beneficiary is not a spouse more than 10 years younger, so the Uniform Lifetime Table applies.
Born before 1951: the required beginning date passed under the earlier law (age 70 1/2 for anyone born before July 1, 1949; age 72 for anyone born July 1, 1949 through 1950); distributions are required every year, including 2026.
Uniform Lifetime Table (26 CFR 1.401(a)(9)-9(c)), age 90: distribution period 12.2.
RMD = account balance at December 31, 2025, 123,456.78 / 12.2 = 10119.4082, rounded to the cent = 10,119.41.
